description: LESH towAction levels the towed vehicle and pushes it down whenever its model origin is more than 0.3 m above the ground. An aircraft with a tall origin and a nose-up stance, such as the Typhoon, is therefore pressed into the ground and pitched up on hook-up. Hold the pitch and height the vehicle had when the tow started, change only its heading, and rotate about the same tow pivot. Remove this manifest when LESH keeps the towed vehicle's stance.

ops.replace: private _hold = _target getVariable ["LESH_rest", [objNull, 0, 0]]; if ((_hold select 0) != _tower) then { _hold = [_tower, (vectorDir _target) select 2, (getPosATL _target) select 2]; _target setVariable ["LESH_rest", _hold] }; private _pitch = _hold select 1; private _flat = sqrt (1 - _pitch * _pitch); _vectorDir = [(sin _direction) * _flat, (cos _direction) * _flat, _pitch];

private _pivot = _target modelToWorldVisual _target_wheel_offset; _target setVectorDirAndUp [_vectorDir, [-(sin _direction) * _pitch, -(cos _direction) * _pitch, _flat]]; _target setPosWorld ((getPosWorld _target) vectorAdd (_pivot vectorDiff (_target modelToWorldVisual _target_wheel_offset)));
_target setAngularVelocity [0, 0, 0];
